attributes.name: Single Trip Plan
attributes.reviewNote:
Single Trip Plan (jetlagbye_trip_pass) is a consumable purchase that grants one additional complete one-way or round-trip itinerary after the user's first free itinerary.

Review path:
1. On a device with no existing complimentary-itinerary eligibility record, complete onboarding and create the first itinerary for free. A device-local iOS Keychain marker intentionally prevents reinstalling the App on a previously tested device from resetting the offer. Restoring an Apple device backup may also preserve local eligibility state.
2. Return to the home screen and start another travel plan.
3. Enter a valid future itinerary and continue to the purchase screen.
4. Choose Single Trip Plan.

The verified purchase grants one local plan credit. The credit is consumed only after the new itinerary is generated and saved successfully. A failed generation does not consume access. If Apple later refunds or revokes the transaction, the App removes that transaction's credit only when it is still unused; an itinerary already generated with it remains saved. Single Trip Plan is intentionally not restorable because it is a consumable; Restore Purchases restores active subscriptions only. No account, reviewer credentials, or special hardware are required.
